title: Customer Due Diligence Standard 01
content:
Document ID: RI360-DOC-001
Title: Customer Due Diligence Standard 01
Domain: AML
Authority: Synthetic EU Banking Guidance
Effective date: 2026-01-02

Purpose
This synthetic document defines risk-based controls for customer due diligence in a banking environment.

Control requirements
1. Apply documented risk-based controls using customer, transaction, geography, counterparty and channel attributes.
2. Review material alerts promptly and retain the evidence, analyst rationale, disposition and approvals.
3. Higher-risk activity requires enhanced review and escalation according to documented thresholds.
4. Potentially suspicious or fraudulent activity must be linked to a case with traceable transaction evidence.
5. Automated controls require monitoring for quality, false positives, drift, overrides and exceptions.

Evidence standard
A finding should identify source transaction IDs, customer ID, triggering indicators, applicable control text, document ID and analyst conclusion.

Disclaimer
Synthetic demonstration content only. This is not legal or regulatory advice and does not reproduce an official regulation.
